advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Consider giving the not-initialized RebarError a stable error_code (e.g. "store_not_initialized") and matching on it in _audited_tickets instead of the message substring, to decouple the audit-index guard from the guard's prose.
evidence: src/rebar/_reads.py:43: `raise _rebar_error("Error: ticket system not initialized. Run 'ticket init' first.")`

_rebar_error sets no error_code for the not-initialized case (src/rebar/_reads.py:52-60 constructs RebarError(message, returncode=1, stderr=message) with no error_code), so a structured code is unavailable and string-matching is the only current discriminator.
advisory.finding: The audit server's uninitialized-store guard keys on the substring "not initialized" in the RebarError message (server.py:99) rather than a stable machine-readable error_code. The guard message is defined independently in _reads._tracker() (_reads.py:43); if that wording is ever changed, _audited_tickets will stop matching and the read-only audit index will start returning 500 on a storeless repo — the exact regression this change removes — with no compile-time or test linkage between the two strings except the added regression test.
scenarios: A later change reworems the not-initialized guard message in _reads.py without updating server.py, silently reintroducing the 500.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that monkeypatches rebar.list_tickets to raise a RebarError with a non-'not initialized' message and asserts _audited_tickets re-raises (does not return []).
evidence: src/rebar/audit/server.py:98-100: `except rebar.RebarError as exc:` / `if "not initialized" not in str(exc):` / `raise`
Docstring claim src/rebar/audit/server.py:93-94: 'every OTHER failure still propagates, so a genuinely broken store is not silently blanked.'

The new test only exercises the degrade path: tests/unit/test_reads_uninitialized_store.py `test_audit_index_renders_empty_rather_than_500ing_without_a_store` asserts `_audited_tickets(repo_root=str(repo)) == []` against a bare (uninitialized) repo — a RebarError with a non-'not initialized' message is never injected.

Named violating input: a RebarError raised by rebar.list_tickets whose str() does not contain 'not initialized' (e.g. a corrupt store) — a regression narrowing to `except rebar.RebarError: return out` would swallow it into an empty page undetected.
advisory.finding: The re-raise branch in _audited_tickets (a RebarError whose message does NOT contain 'not initialized' must propagate) is newly added and untested. Only the degrade-to-empty branch is covered; the promised 'every OTHER failure still propagates' contract has no regression guard.
scenarios: A future edit widens the except clause or drops the substring guard; a genuinely broken store then renders as an empty index instead of a 500, and no test fails.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add to tests/unit/test_reads_uninitialized_store.py a test that monkeypatches rebar.list_tickets to raise `rebar.RebarError('some other failure')` and asserts `pytest.raises(rebar.RebarError)` from `_audited_tickets(...)`, confirming the non-uninitialized branch propagates.
